'''Garek Tolas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and later, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
Tolas originally served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as a member of the [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Imperial Special Forces]]. However, after he began to be given assignments that involved killing civilians, Tolas defected and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], becoming a member of the crew of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]''. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Tolas and the rest of the crew of the ''Katarn'' were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]], to find [[Caeleb]], the "Child of Light". Tolas helped to defeat the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]], who had tried to capture Caeleb and the Rebels.<ref name="COL" />

Four months later, Caeleb was kidnapped by [[Thaum Rystra]] and the crew of the ''Katarn'' were again dispatched to find the child. They tracked Rystra to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and again to the planet [[Pamorjal]]. However, the ''Lazy Katarn'' was destroyed by the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]], so Tolas and the other Rebels began to fly the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Celestial Dancer]]'' instead. They eventually attacked Rystra inside the [[Cavern of Light]] and rescued Caeleb.<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref>

Afterward, Tolas married [[Mina Dhori Tolas|Mina Dhori]] and when the Alliance reformed into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], he served the new government. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Tolas and the crew of the ''Dancer'' traveled to the [[Temple of Pain]] in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]], where they confronted Rystra and the spirit of the Sith consort [[Valik Kodank]].<ref name="LAD" />
